payload.friendly_name: Host-aware mode predicate for tool-surface planners
payload.purpose_context: On Windows the file system reports fixed modes, so planners that compare the observed mode with a planned POSIX mode plan a chmod that never takes effect: the startup skill sync and upgrade --dry-run report the same phantom repairs forever, while doctor says the project is clean. This Mission makes one host-aware mode comparison the only way planners decide mode equality and adds an architectural gate that keeps it that way (#4927, #4810).
payload.purpose_tldr: A converged Windows project stops re-planning file-mode repairs it can never apply, on every CLI start and every upgrade preview.

options: Operator rulings 2026-11-20 (one host-aware predicate + folded #4810 ratchet gate; Windows: dirs kind-only, files write bit, symlinks ignore mode; POSIX raw; latent sites included; charter_yaml_io campsite)
payload.question: What is in scope and what are the Windows mode semantics for the shared predicate?
